audit_result.proof_trace: The time gate (22:50–23:50 JST) is enforced only in the HTTP API route (`src/app/api/admin/force-logout-all/route.ts:L16-25`), but the admin UI (`SystemTab.tsx:L34`) calls `forceLogoutAll` directly as a Next.js Server Action (`'use server'`), a completely separate execution path that never passes through `route.ts`. The Server Action (`actions.ts:L631-679`) contains zero time gate checks, so the property `current_time_jst >= 22:50 AND current_time_jst <= 23:50` is never evaluated on the admin UI path.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An admin opens the admin panel → navigates to the System tab → clicks '全員を強制ログアウトさせる' at any time of day (e.g., 09:00 JST during peak work hours) → confirms the dialog → `forceLogoutAll()` Server Action executes unconditionally, forcibly clocking out all currently clocked-in employees with no time restriction.

PROP-e5782b58-pre-002.text: Force-logout-all must enforce time-gate restriction (22:50-23:50 JST) before execution.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-002.assertion: forall req to force-logout-all: current_time_jst >= 22:50 AND current_time_jst <= 23:50
